detached_structure.evidence: A small light-colored object sits near the north of the central house, but it is too small to identify as a structure. The larger building at the top is probably on a neighboring lot.

signals.notes: The central house is heavily shaded by dense mature tree canopy, with a dark paved driveway curving in from the southwest and a small lawn patch to the west; roof shows some gray weathering and shadow, so condition is hard to judge.
